 Shri Dharmendra Chelawat, counsel for the petitioner.
 Shri Lokesh Mehta, Ga for the respondent / State.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 Crr-4240-2019
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard on the question of admission.
Also heard on I.A.No. 7121/2019 for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the petitioner.

The petitioner has been convicted under section 16(1)(a)
(i) and (ii) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo six months R.I with fine of Rs. 1000/- on each count.
It has been submitted on behalf of the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present offence.
There is no possibility of final hearing of the revision at an early date.
A bare perusal of the records, it reveals that the petitioner has fair chance of success in the revision.
and therefore, he prays for grant of bail and suspension of jail sentence.

Learned GA for the respondent / State opposes the application stating that no case is made out for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail as there is ample evidence available on record against the present petitioner.

Taking into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case as also the record of the trial Court, I.A.Nos. 7121/2019 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the petitioner is allowed.

It is directed that on deposition of fine amount and also on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before this Court/Registry on 11/12/2019 and on all other subsequent dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this behalf, the execution of substantial Yogesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 28 August, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159407532/
